title: Research Industry Promotion Act
full_text:
RESEARCH INDUSTRY PROMOTION ACT

CHAPTER I GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to lay the foundation for the development of the research industry and to enhance its competitiveness by prescribing matters necessary for promoting industries related to research and development activities in science and technology, thereby contributing to the improvement of people's lives and the development of the national economy.

Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in this Act are defined as follows:
1. "Research industry" means any of the following industries related to research and development activities in science and technology:
(a) An industry that independently conducts research and development, or conducts all or part of research and development entrusted to it by an external entity;
(b) An industry that supports research and development activities, including planning research and development, supporting the management and commercialization of research and development, and investigating and providing technical information related to research and development;
(c) An industry that develops, modifies, maintains, or repairs equipment, peripheral systems, and components used for research and development;
(d) An industry that develops and supplies materials or substances required for research and development.
2. "Research business operator" means a person who engages in the research industry.
3. "Specialized research business operator" means a person who engages in the research industry with specialized expertise and has filed a report under Article 6(1).

Article 3 (Responsibilities of the State and Local Governments)
The State and local governments shall establish and implement various policies necessary for promoting the research industry.

CHAPTER II ESTABLISHMENT OF MASTER PLANS FOR RESEARCH INDUSTRY PROMOTION

Article 4 (Establishment of Master Plans for Research Industry Promotion)
① The Minister of Science and ICT shall establish and implement a master plan for research industry promotion (hereinafter referred to as the "master plan") every five years to set mid- to long-term policy objectives and directions for promoting the research industry.
② The master plan shall include the following matters:
1. Basic objectives and directions of policies for research industry promotion;
2. Policies for the promotion of each sector of the research industry;
3. Development and support of research business operators;
4. Training of professional personnel for the research industry;
5. Securing and allocation of financial resources for research industry promotion;
6. Other matters necessary for promoting the research industry.
③ The Minister of Science and ICT shall establish and implement an annual implementation plan for research industry promotion (hereinafter referred to as an "implementation plan") in accordance with the master plan.
④ Other matters necessary for the establishment and implementation of master plans and implementation plans shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 5 (Compilation of Statistics on the Research Industry)
① The Minister of Science and ICT may compile and manage statistics on the research industry to promote the research industry.
② The Minister of Science and ICT may conduct fact-finding surveys to compile statistics under paragraph ① and, where necessary, may request relevant public institutions, corporations, organizations, and other entities to submit data or present opinions.
③ Matters necessary for the subjects and frequency of statistical compilation under paragraph ① and methods of fact-finding surveys under paragraph ② shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
④ Except as otherwise provided in this Act, the Statistics Act shall apply mutatis mutandis to the compilation and management of statistics under paragraph ①.

CHAPTER III DEVELOPMENT AND SUPPORT OF THE RESEARCH INDUSTRY

Article 6 (Reporting by Specialized Research Business Operators)
① A research business operator intending to receive support under this Act shall meet requirements prescribed by Presidential Decree, including requirements concerning professional personnel, and file a report as a specialized research business operator with the Minister of Science and ICT.
② If an important matter prescribed by Presidential Decree among the matters reported by a specialized research business operator under paragraph ① changes, the operator shall file a report on the change with the Minister of Science and ICT.
③ Upon receipt of a report under paragraph ① or a report on a change under paragraph ②, the Minister of Science and ICT shall review its contents and, if it complies with this Act, accept the report within 30 days from the date of receipt.
④ If the Minister of Science and ICT fails to notify the reporting person, within the period specified in paragraph ③, of whether the report has been accepted or of an extension of the processing period under statutes governing the handling of civil petitions, the report shall be deemed accepted on the day following the expiration of that period (or, where the processing period has been extended or re-extended under those statutes, the relevant extended processing period).
⑤ A report under paragraph ① shall remain valid for three years from the date of its acceptance; a person intending to continue receiving support under this Act shall renew the report.
⑥ Matters necessary for requirements for reports and reports on changes under paragraphs ① through ⑤, processing of acceptance of reports, and procedures for renewing reports shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 7 (Strengthening Research Capabilities and Supporting Commercialization)
① The head of a central administrative agency shall endeavor to increase opportunities for specialized research business operators to participate in national research and development projects under Article 11 of the Framework Act on Science and Technology (hereinafter referred to as "national research and development projects").
② The Minister of Science and ICT shall promote national research and development projects for technological progress and advancement of the research industry and shall establish and implement policies to support technological progress.
③ In promoting national research and development projects or establishing policies under paragraph ②, the Minister of Science and ICT may reflect the needs of relevant specialized research business operators.

Article 8 (Performance Evaluation of Research Equipment)
① To ensure the reliability of equipment developed by research business operators for use in research and development (hereinafter referred to as "research equipment"), the Minister of Science and ICT may evaluate the performance of such equipment (hereinafter referred to as "research equipment performance evaluation").
② The Government may provide necessary support, including promotion of distribution and preferential government purchasing, for research equipment that receives an excellent rating in a research equipment performance evaluation.
③ The Minister of Science and ICT may designate evaluation institutions to conduct research equipment performance evaluations professionally.
④ The Minister of Science and ICT may revoke the designation of an evaluation institution under paragraph ③ if the institution falls under any of the following subparagraphs:
1. Where the designation was obtained by fraud or other improper means;
2. Where the evaluation institution no longer meets the requirements for designation.
⑤ Matters necessary for methods, procedures, standards, and indication of results of research equipment performance evaluations under paragraph ①, designation of evaluation institutions under paragraph ③, and revocation of designation under paragraph ④ shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 9 (Establishment of Research Industry Promotion Complexes)
① Where necessary to promote the research industry, the Minister of Science and ICT may designate as a research industry promotion complex an area in which research business operators and their support facilities are collectively located or intend to locate, or may directly develop such an area and designate it as a research industry promotion complex.
② The Minister of Science and ICT may conduct the following projects within a research industry promotion complex and provide budgetary support necessary for them:
1. Installation and operation of industrial infrastructure and research and development infrastructure to revitalize a research industry promotion complex;
2. Other projects necessary for the development of the area in which a research industry promotion complex is located.
③ The Minister of Science and ICT may revoke the designation of a research industry promotion complex designated under paragraph ① if it falls under any of the following subparagraphs:
1. Where designation was obtained by fraud or other improper means;
2. Where the research industry promotion complex no longer meets the requirements for designation under paragraph ④.
④ Requirements for designation of research industry promotion complexes under paragraph ①, procedures for revocation under paragraph ③, and other matters necessary for designation and development shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 10 (Promotion of International Cooperation and Overseas Expansion)
① The Minister of Science and ICT may support the following projects to promote international cooperation and overseas expansion by specialized research business operators:
1. Provision of information, consultation, advice, and education concerning overseas expansion by specialized research business operators;
2. Provision of technical information concerning overseas research business operators and support for protecting the technologies of domestic specialized research business operators;
3. Identification of difficulties associated with overseas expansion by specialized research business operators and support for resolving such difficulties;
4. Other projects that the Minister of Science and ICT deems necessary to promote international cooperation and overseas expansion by specialized research business operators.
② The Minister of Science and ICT may have an institution or organization prescribed by Presidential Decree conduct the projects under paragraph ① and may provide budgetary support necessary for them.

Article 11 (Creation of a Fair Market Environment)
① A person entering into a contract with a research business operator shall not use that person's position to compel the operator to enter into an unfair contract or gain an undue benefit, such as by demanding the unilateral transfer of intellectual property rights held by the operator without reasonable grounds.
② If a person entering into a contract with a research business operator violates paragraph ①, the Minister of Science and ICT may request the head of a relevant institution to take necessary measures, including corrective measures.
③ In consultation with the heads of relevant institutions, the Minister of Science and ICT may investigate and analyze the competitive environment in the research industry market and unfair practices related to paragraph ①, and establish policies necessary to improve that environment.
④ To establish a fair order of transactions in the use of products and services supplied by research business operators, the Minister of Science and ICT may, following consultation with the Fair Trade Commission, prepare a standard contract and recommend its use when relevant contracts are concluded.

Article 12 (Financial Support)
The State and local governments may take necessary measures, including financial and administrative support, for specialized research business operators and persons employed by them to promote the research industry.

Article 13 (Establishment of Association)
① Research business operators may establish a Research Industry Association (hereinafter referred to as the "Association") with authorization from the Minister of Science and ICT in order to strengthen the capabilities of the research industry and develop the foundation for the industry.
② Matters necessary for the business of the Association, matters to be stated in its articles of incorporation, procedures for authorization, and supervision of the Association shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
③ Except as otherwise provided in this Act, the provisions of the Civil Act concerning incorporated associations shall apply mutatis mutandis to the Association.

Article 14 (Designation of Dedicated Institutions)
① In order to promote the research industry and develop research business operators, the Minister of Science and ICT may designate a dedicated institution for research industry promotion (hereinafter referred to as a "dedicated institution") from among the following institutions:
1. The Science and Technology Job Promotion Agency established with permission from the Minister of Science and ICT under Article 32 of the Civil Act and the Act on the Establishment and Operation of Public Interest Corporations;
2. Any other institution recognized by the Minister of Science and ICT as having the professional personnel and dedicated organization necessary for promoting the research industry.
② The Minister of Science and ICT may make contributions or provide subsidies to cover all or part of the expenses necessary for a dedicated institution to conduct its business.
③ If a dedicated institution designated under paragraph ① becomes unable to continue performing its duties due to serious grounds relating to the public interest or other reasons, the Minister of Science and ICT may revoke its designation.
④ Matters necessary for the designation, operation, and revocation of designation of dedicated institutions shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

CHAPTER IV SUPPLEMENTARY PROVISIONS AND PENALTY PROVISIONS

Article 15 (Reporting and Investigation)
① Where the Minister of Science and ICT deems it necessary for the enforcement of this Act, including ascertaining violations of requirements for reporting or designation or supervising the Association or a dedicated institution, the Minister may require a specialized research business operator, the Association, a dedicated institution, or another relevant entity to report or submit relevant matters as prescribed by Presidential Decree, or may have a public official under the Minister's authority enter a business establishment, office, or other relevant place to investigate those matters.
② Where an investigation is to be conducted by entering a business establishment, office, or other place under paragraph ①, an investigation plan stating the date and time, reasons, and details of the investigation shall be notified to the person subject to the investigation not later than seven days before the commencement of the investigation: Provided, That this shall not apply where giving advance notice is deemed likely to prevent achievement of the purpose of the investigation due to destruction of evidence or other reasons.
③ A public official conducting an investigation under paragraph ① shall carry identification indicating the official's authority and present it to relevant persons.

Article 16 (Entrustment of Duties)
The Minister of Science and ICT may entrust part of the duties under this Act to the Association, a dedicated institution, or an institution or organization prescribed by Presidential Decree, and may provide support for expenses necessary to perform the entrusted duties.

Article 17 (Persons Deemed Public Officials for Application of Penalty Provisions)
For purposes of applying Article 127 and Articles 129 through 132 of the Criminal Act, the executives and employees of an institution or organization engaged in duties entrusted under Article 16 shall be deemed public officials.

Article 18 (Administrative Fines)
① An administrative fine not exceeding one million won shall be imposed on a person falling under any of the following subparagraphs:
1. A person who files a report under Article 6(1) or a report on a change under paragraph (2) of that Article by fraud or other improper means;
2. A person who fails to report or submit matters under Article 15(1), or submits a false report or false information;
3. A person who obstructs or refuses to comply with an investigation by a public official under Article 15(1).
② Administrative fines under paragraph ① shall be imposed and collected by the Minister of Science and ICT as prescribed by Presidential Decree.

ADDENDA <Act No. 18075, Apr. 20, 2021>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measure Concerning Reports on Research and Development Service Business)
An enterprise whose report as a research and development service business was accepted before this Act enters into force under Article 18 of the Special Act on Support for Scientists and Engineers for Strengthening National Science and Technology Competitiveness shall be deemed a specialized research business operator whose report has been accepted under Article 6 of this Act.

Article 3 (Transitional Measure Concerning the Korea Research and Development Service Association)
The Korea Research and Development Service Association, established under Article 32 of the Civil Act as at the time this Act enters into force, shall be deemed the Association established under Article 13 of this Act. In such cases, the Korea Research and Development Service Association shall amend its articles of incorporation and related documents to comply with this Act within three months from the date this Act enters into force.

Article 4 (Amendments to Other Acts)
① The Special Act on Support for Scientists and Engineers for Strengthening National Science and Technology Competitiveness is partially amended as follows:
Subparagraph 4 of Article 2 and Articles 18 and 19 are each deleted.

② The Special Act on the Establishment and Support of the International Science and Business Belt is partially amended as follows:
In Article 32(1), "research and development service business under subparagraph 4 of Article 2 of the Special Act on Support for Scientists and Engineers for Strengthening National Science and Technology Competitiveness" is replaced with "a specialized research business operator under subparagraph 3 of Article 2 of the Research Industry Promotion Act".

③ The Act on Promotion of Agricultural and Food Science and Technology is partially amended as follows:
Article 6(2) 4-2 is replaced with the following:
4-2. A specialized research business operator who has filed a report under Article 6(1) of the Research Industry Promotion Act.

④ The Energy Act is partially amended as follows:
Subparagraph 8 of Article 12(1) is replaced with the following:
8. An enterprise specializing in the business referred to in Article 2, subparagraph 1(a), of the Research Industry Promotion Act.

⑤ The Special Act on the Promotion of Special Research and Development Zones is partially amended as follows:
In Article 8(2), "research and development service business under subparagraph 4 of Article 2 of the Special Act on Support for Scientists and Engineers for Strengthening National Science and Technology Competitiveness" is replaced with "a specialized research business operator under subparagraph 3 of Article 2 of the Research Industry Promotion Act".

⑥ The Restriction of Special Taxation Act is partially amended as follows:
Item po of Article 7(1) 1 is replaced with the following:
po. The industry described in Article 2, subparagraph 1(b), of the Research Industry Promotion Act.

⑦ The Act on the Promotion of Technology Innovation of Small and Medium Enterprises is partially amended as follows:
In Article 24(1), "research and development service business" is replaced with "research industry".

⑧ The Restriction of Special Local Taxation Act is partially amended as follows:
Item po of Article 101(1) 1 is replaced with the following:
po. The industry described in Article 2, subparagraph 1(b), of the Research Industry Promotion Act.

Article 5 (Relationship to Other Statutes)
If another statute or regulation refers, at the time this Act enters into force, to a provision of the former Special Act on Support for Scientists and Engineers for Strengthening National Science and Technology Competitiveness, and this Act contains a corresponding provision, the reference shall be deemed to be to this Act or to that corresponding provision of this Act in place of the former provision.
